Algebraic multigrid preconditioner

Source: R/sparse-solvers.R
amg_preconditioner.Rd

Builds a smoothed aggregation V-cycle from the matrix alone, so it applies to P2 spaces, unstructured meshes and systems without a mesh hierarchy, where multigrid_preconditioner() does not. Unknowns are grouped into aggregates of strongly connected neighbors (|a_ij| >= strength * sqrt(a_ii a_jj)); the tentative prolongation is piecewise constant on the aggregates and, with smoothed = TRUE, is improved by one damped Jacobi step. Coarse operators are Galerkin products, smoothing is symmetric Gauss-Seidel and the coarsest level (at most coarse_size unknowns) is solved directly. It targets scalar symmetric positive definite systems such as diffusion problems; use it with method = "cg".

Usage

amg_preconditioner(
  strength = 0.08,
  smoothed = TRUE,
  smoothing = 1L,
  coarse_size = 300L
)

Arguments

strength

Strength of connection threshold in [0, 1).

smoothed

Smooth the tentative prolongation.

smoothing

Gauss-Seidel sweeps before and after the coarse correction.

coarse_size

Largest system solved directly.

Value

An object of class pde_preconditioner; its setup time is recorded in the solver diagnostics as part of the solve time.

References

Vanek, P., Mandel, J. and Brezina, M. (1996). Algebraic multigrid by smoothed aggregation for second and fourth order elliptic problems. Computing, 56, 179-196.

Examples

prob <- poisson_problem(pde_mesh_rectangle(nx = 24), source = 1,
                        boundary = dirichlet_bc(0), degree = 2)
sol <- solve_pde(prob, method = "cg", preconditioner = amg_preconditioner())
sol$diagnostics$solver$iterations
#> [1] 22
